top_posts.text: Few months ago, I said Berkshire Hathaway buying Google at $300+ was a wrong move, I was downvoted into oblivion...    I am a huge fan of Warren Buffett and Berkshire Hathaway that it is the largest position in my portfolio. I always talked positive about the man and the company. But this time, him buying Google at the peak was a total nonsense. He never understood tech stocks and never will.   I
